evidence.excerpt: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image.
